Subject: AWS Marketplace metering evidence & entitlement mapping — Acme Analytics contract

Hi Lauren / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. To keep our internal procurement and AWS onboarding moving, we need two things from Redwood by EOD Friday (12/05):

1) A short evidence packet for AWS (SOC2 summary, data handling statement, and a sample call flow showing how metering events are emitted).
2) A mapping document that shows how our contract SKUs / seat counts map to AWS Marketplace entitlements (so our finance team can crosswalk invoices).

We have a target go-live of 2025-12-15 for the Marketplace listing and need the invoice routing details (who receives Marketplace invoices vs. direct Redwood invoices). Can you also confirm if Redwood can surface BillingContact in the metering payload or if that needs to be handled by our billing system?

Attached: acme-sow-summary.pdf (summary of the SOW we had with your sales team).

-Jared
Jared Cole

Jared — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary / next steps from our side: 

- Evidence packet: I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a one-page data handling note by EOD Thursday (12/04).
- Entitlement mapping: Marcus will draft an entitlement spreadsheet that maps your contract line items to AWS Marketplace SKUs and the corresponding metering dimensions.
- Invoice routing: We can support BillingContact as a field in our fulfillment metadata; however, Marketplace invoicing is handled by AWS. We will provide the recommended routing (BillingContact and CustomerAccount fields) that your finance team can use to reconcile.

Action items we need from you:
- Please share the Acme AWS Seller ID and the internal contract number (so Marcus can reference the exact lines).
- If procurement requires a signed PO, please attach it here (we received the SOW but not PO).

Attachments: redwood-entitlement-map-v0.1.xlsx (initial blank template — Marcus will populate with mappings once we have your Seller ID / contract lines).

I'll put this on Monica and Marcus's plate for the handoff; Monica will coordinate the DocuSign & fulfillment steps once we have the PO and Seller ID.

Best,
